Mina (Support): handing to CS  Solace trial can't ingest docs via embeds, ticket #46210. Customer is blocked. :warning:
Luca (Customer Success): Thanks — which trial cohort and when did this start?
Mina (Support): Trial cohort B, started 2026-03-02. First error seen this morning. Sample response below. Eng investigating, no ETA yet.
Mina (Support): ```
POST /v1/embeds 403 Forbidden
{"error":"embed_access_denied", "reason": "quota_or_perm"}
```
Priya (Enablement): Any chance they switched API keys or envs? I can put together a short owner-facing workaround (presigned upload + scoped key) if allowed.
Mina (Support): Customer confirmed keys unchanged. Data includes names/emails, no PHI. They need ingest for evaluation before Friday.
Sam (CS Manager): Renewal risk if they can't evaluate. Luca: propose: 1) immediate customer note acknowledging issue 2) offer 5-day trial extension 3) schedule enablement walkthrough 4) escalate to eng P1 if no ETA in 12h.
Alex (AE): Agreed on pause of renewal outreach. If CS sends a 5-day extension that should keep them engaged.
Luca (Customer Success): I'll draft the comm now. Proposed subject: "Quick update on your Solace trial ingest". Will be transparent about timeline but offer workaround.
Priya (Enablement): Workaround plan: create a presigned ingest endpoint tied to a temp scoped API key + audit logs. I'll write steps + screen-share checklist. Don't recommend bypass headers.
Mina (Support): infra-bot: deployment note -> rate-limit surge at 09:34 UTC.
infra-bot: New alert: inferred rate limit bump in embedding service.
Sam (CS Manager): Action items: Luca send comm in 45m, Priya produce playbook in 3h, Alex update AE notes, Mina to update thread with eng ETA or escalate after 12h. React with :white_check_mark: when done.
Luca (Customer Success): Draft ready in 25m, will post for review.
Priya (Enablement): Starting playbook draft now. Will upload to shared drive and link here.
Alex (AE): I'll prepare renewal hold note and share with Sam.
Mina (Support): Will monitor eng thread and ping infra if more alerts.
Sam (CS Manager): Keep comm tone calm and solution-oriented. If they need immediate demo we'll set up a short screenshare.
